title: TripAdvisor Property Rank Tracker Input
description: Snapshot rank, rating, response rate, and competitor signals for any TripAdvisor hotel, restaurant, or attraction. Paste property URLs or a destination listing URL.

targetUrls.title: Property URLs
targetUrls.description: TripAdvisor property URLs. Hotel_Review, Restaurant_Review, or Attraction_Review pages. Each is snapshotted as one dataset row. Example: 'https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotel_Review-g60763-d93589-Reviews-The_Pierre_A_Taj_Hotel.html'.

destinationUrls.title: Destination listing URLs
destinationUrls.description: TripAdvisor destination listing URLs to sweep top N properties from. Hotels-, Restaurants-, or Attractions- pages. Example: 'https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotels-g60763-New_York_City_New_York-Hotels.html'.

maxPerDestination.title: Max properties per destination URL
maxPerDestination.description: When destination listing URLs are provided, snapshot at most this many top ranked properties per destination. Useful for daily competitor sweeps.

responseRateSampleSize.title: Response rate sample size
responseRateSampleSize.description: Number of recent reviews to sample on each property to compute owner response rate. Bigger samples are more accurate but cost more time. Set to 0 to skip response rate.

extractAmenities.title: Extract amenities and features
extractAmenities.description: Pull the amenity and feature flags TripAdvisor lists on the property page. Adds 200 to 400 ms per property. Built in. No extra cost.

extractRatingHistogram.title: Extract rating histogram
extractRatingHistogram.description: Capture the count of reviews at each star tier (5, 4, 3, 2, 1). Built in. No extra cost.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of properties processed in parallel. TripAdvisor sits behind Cloudflare, so two to four is the safe range with residential proxy.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for TripAdvisor at any meaningful volume.
